description: This file exports specific functions related to command detection, acting as a module that consolidates and re-exports functionalities from the auto-reply command detection module.

methods.name: hasControlCommand
methods.description: Checks if the message contains a control command.

methods.name: hasInlineCommandTokens
methods.description: Detects inline command tokens within a message.

methods.name: isControlCommandMessage
methods.description: Determines if a message is a control command message.

methods.name: shouldComputeCommandAuthorized
methods.description: Decides if computation of command authorization is needed.
